intro.text: The senior elder of the Terris refugees staying at the Pits of Hathsin.

items.text: When Sazed asked him and the other Terris leaders about the daymists, they told him the mistsickness didn't affect Terris people and that they thought it a myth.
Wondered why Sazed no longer wore his metalminds openly, and with the others hoped Sazed would stay and lead the Terrismen.
